categories.main_business_segments: Highwoods Properties, Inc. operates primarily as a fully integrated office real estate investment trust (REIT), focused on the ownership, development, acquisition, leasing, and management of office properties. The company’s core business is concentrated in high-quality office buildings located in the best business districts (BBDs) of major Southeastern and Sunbelt U.S. cities, including Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Nashville, Orlando, Raleigh, Richmond, and Tampa. There are no material inter-segment transactions, and the company does not report significant diversification outside of office real estate.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Highwoods employs a fully integrated operational model, handling leasing, property management, maintenance, and customer service in-house rather than outsourcing. The company emphasizes proactive building maintenance, tenant improvements, build-to-suit construction, and sustainability initiatives such as energy efficiency, carbon reduction, and water conservation. Technology is leveraged for building operations, customer service tracking, and cybersecurity, with a dedicated IT steering committee and regular cybersecurity training and audits.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a diverse base of approximately 1,500 tenants, primarily large corporations, financial institutions, government agencies, and professional services firms. Major customers include Bank of America, Asurion, Metropolitan Life Insurance, the Federal Government, and Bridgestone Americas, with no single tenant accounting for more than 4% of annualized revenue. The end markets are predominantly office users seeking high-quality, amenity-rich workspaces in urban and suburban business districts.
categories.geographic_coverage: Highwoods’ operations are geographically diversified across the Southeastern and Sunbelt regions of the United States, with core markets in Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Nashville, Orlando, Raleigh, Richmond, and Tampa. The company does not have significant dependence on any single market, with its largest markets (Nashville and Raleigh) each representing about 20% of annualized rental revenue. The portfolio includes properties in both urban and suburban BBDs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Highwoods operates at the downstream end of the commercial real estate supply chain, directly interfacing with end users (tenants) by providing office space and related services. The company is also involved in the development and redevelopment of office properties, occasionally partnering in joint ventures for new construction, but its primary role is as a landlord and property operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on owning and operating high-quality, differentiated office buildings in dynamic BBDs, maintaining a strong and flexible balance sheet, and recycling capital from non-core assets into higher-performing properties. Innovation themes include workplace placemaking, sustainability (energy, carbon, water reduction), and resilience (environmental and operational). Highwoods invests in talent development, diversity, and technology to enhance operational efficiency and customer experience.
categories.revenue_model: Highwoods generates revenue primarily through rental income from office leases, including base rent, cost recovery income (for property taxes, insurance, and maintenance), and parking income. Additional revenue streams include development, management, and leasing fees from joint ventures, as well as gains from property dispositions. The company’s leases are typically long-term, with built-in rent escalations and cost recovery provisions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Highwoods competes with other office REITs, institutional investors, pension funds, private equity, and local/regional property owners and developers. Key competitive factors include location, building quality, amenities, service, and price. The company positions itself as a leader in high-quality, amenitized office environments in growth markets, with a fully integrated operational model and a focus on customer experience and sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, Highwoods had total assets of approximately $6.0 billion and a market capitalization of about $3.4 billion. Annual rental and other revenues were $825.9 million in 2024, with funds from operations (FFO) available for common stockholders of $391.2 million. The company’s portfolio comprised 27.2 million rentable square feet with an average occupancy of 87.1%. Recent years have seen modest revenue declines due to property dispositions and lower occupancy, but the company maintains a conservative leverage profile and continues to invest in development and redevelopment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Highwoods differentiates itself through its focus on high-quality, commute-worthy office environments in vibrant business districts, a fully integrated service model, and a commitment to sustainability and resiliency. The company emphasizes superior customer experience, operational efficiency, and proactive property management, which it believes leads to higher tenant retention and satisfaction. Its development-ready land bank and in-house expertise provide flexibility and speed to market for new projects.
